name: pomo
description: A focus dashboard for Claude Code: a ring that burns down through 25, 50 or flow blocks, a parking lot for stray thoughts, a check-in after each block, Do Not Disturb while you focus, Claude kept on your task, brown, pink or white noise, and logging to your Obsidian daily note.

openOnStart.title: Open the dashboard at start
openOnStart.description: Open the focus dashboard beside the chat when a session starts.

longBreakMinutes.title: Long break minutes
longBreakMinutes.description: Break after every set of blocks.

longBreakEvery.title: Blocks per set
longBreakEvery.description: How many focus blocks come before a long break.

autoStartBreaks.title: Start breaks by themselves
autoStartBreaks.description: When a focus block ends, the break starts straight away.

autoStartFocus.title: Start focus by itself after a break
autoStartFocus.description: Off means you choose when the next block starts.

dailyGoal.title: Daily goal
dailyGoal.description: Focus blocks to aim for each day. 0 hides the goal.

sound.title: Chimes
sound.description: A soft chime when a block or a break ends.

showSeconds.title: Show seconds
showSeconds.description: Off shows minutes only, which is less to watch.

showWhenIdle.title: Show when idle
showWhenIdle.description: Keep a quiet Start button above the prompt between blocks.

vaultPath.title: Obsidian vault
vaultPath.description: Empty finds your vault by itself: the folder the session is in, then the vault Obsidian has open. Give an absolute path to choose another. "off" turns logging off.

vaultProperty.title: Daily note property
vaultProperty.description: The frontmatter number each finished block adds to.

vaultUnit.title: Log as
vaultUnit.description: Add the block's minutes, or 1 per block.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: An IANA zone such as Australia/Perth, for which day a block counts on. Empty uses this computer's.

noiseVolume.title: Noise volume
noiseVolume.description: From 0 to 1, for the brown, pink or white noise bed.

noiseQuietInBreaks.title: Quiet noise in breaks
noiseQuietInBreaks.description: The noise bed stops for breaks and pauses, as a cue to step away.

focusSwitch.title: Silence notifications in blocks
focusSwitch.description: auto silences desktop notifications for each focus block (Omarchy's shell, mako, SwayNC, dunst or GNOME) and brings them back for the break. off leaves them alone. The dashboard's own switch overrides this once you use it.

fullscreen.title: Fullscreen during focus (Hyprland)
fullscreen.description: Maximize the Claude window for each focus block and restore it for the break. Hyprland only.

focusStartCommand.title: Command when a block starts
focusStartCommand.description: Any shell command to run as a focus block starts, such as a site blocker, or on macOS: shortcuts run "Focus On".

focusEndCommand.title: Command when a block ends
focusEndCommand.description: The command that undoes it, run as the block ends, pauses or is given up.

keepClaudeOnTask.title: Keep Claude on task
keepClaudeOnTask.description: During a block, tell Claude what it is for, so it keeps replies tight and offers to park unrelated asks.

parkToVault.title: Parked thoughts to the daily note
parkToVault.description: Add each parked thought under a heading in that day's daily note.

parkHeading.title: Heading for parked thoughts
parkHeading.description: The daily note heading parked thoughts go under.
